grant.argvContract: Same exact 17 pairs and app-server --stdio --strict-config as frozen previous profile; only new client/request/grant/evidence identities. No extra config flags, endpoint, model, provider or permission change.
grant.existingAuth: ChatGPT, no credential copying, reads or account/auth RPC
grant.notificationRule: Only exact schema-valid disabled status is discarded without reply. Any warning/provisional, other/invalid notification, server request or auth activity stops.
grant.preconditions: Keep accepted selected_feature_contract.py and all historical artifacts byte-identical. Minimal new client identity/profile and explicit preliminary-vs-final outcome, no generalized runner work. Add focused actual sanitizer/assessor/response-gate cases using explicit raw envelopes; no test helper silently substitutes null. Verify configured requirements null, present-object optional featureRequirements omitted/null/empty/compatible, absent final response/missing whole field and malformed/conflicting/unknown map cases. Positive optional cases only when all other gates pass; no absent RPC/placeholder accepted. Run only changed focused tests; independent source plus exact prestart binding review, clean source and fresh request/freeze/reservation before one launch. Do not rerun full unchanged parser or product suites.
grant.publicCwdRule: Reuse exact existing public metadata cwd and README bytes, no new task inputs. Unexpected extra/changed content stops; no deletion or cleanup. Separate new evidence directory and one new reservation/start.
grant.assessment: Eight selected effective config values required. Actual successful configRequirements/read must be received. Whole requirements:null is schema-defined no configured requirements; present requirements object with omitted/null/empty featureRequirements is a valid no-reported-feature-constraint state, not unresolved by presence alone. Preserve states; do not invent empty maps or booleans. This never overrides other constraints/gates. Missing whole requirements field or final response stays insufficient under this bounded observation contract. Invalid map/value, unknown boolean names, known selected conflicts and other unresolved constraints remain nonpositive.
grant.stopRule: First nonpositive, missing/ambiguous input, resource/deadline or policy condition terminates. No retry, repair-and-relaunch, alternate transport or additional diagnostic. Conditional requirements RPC only after positive config precheck.
grant.ledgerBoundary: No edits to five historical liveledgers or old metadata receipts. Separate fresh metadata reservation and additive accounting (4->at most5).
grant.claimBoundary: Only prospective reported configuration/requirements observations. No inline-key recognition, enforcement, active profile, real tools, serving identity or historical denial cause. Per-feature origins not proven by value alone.
grant.exitCondition: One terminal result or concrete preparation blocker; clean final SHA, sanitized receipts/timing/counters, independent postreview, explicit slot release and one direct callback. Preserve R2 reports with additive adjudication and log-hash erratum. Residual expires; no automatic further diagnostics/Actor.
